package rest

import "testing"

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	r := &Request{verb: "POST", resource: "secrets", resourceName: "example", namespace: "default", namespaceSet: true}
	if r.Body("payload") != r {
		t.Fatal("Body lost receiver")
	}
	result := r.Do()
	if value, err := result.Get(); value != "payload" || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("changed response: %v %v", value, err)
	}
}
